sentences.en: Your father went through all that trouble for your sake.
sentences.zh: 为了你的缘故，你父亲费了那么大的劲。

sentences.en: For thy sake, tobacco, I would do anything but die.
sentences.zh: 为了你的缘故，烟草，我愿意做任何事除了死。

sentences.en: I'll quit my job for the sake of my health.

senses.zh: 目的; 理由; 缘故; 利益, 好处; 清酒(一种日本米酒)
